headline: KUR disbursement reaches Rp 169 trillion, banks step up lending
summary: KUR disbursement in 2026 has reached Rp169 trillion against a government target of Rp290 trillion. Banks are stepping up lending while the government maintains credit quality for MSMEs.
why: KUR is a government-backed credit program for micro, small and medium enterprises, and its lending volumes indicate bank activity and support for the domestic economy.
